programme.title: Africa's Deadliest

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest

programme.title: Yukon Vet
programme.desc: Reindeer Pains: Dr Oakley vaccinates lynx kittens at the Yukon Nature Reserve. She also drives to the rescue of a sickly reindeer, a hungry moose and an injured deer. (S1, ep 2) 7+

programme.title: Cruise TV With LoveitBookit
programme.desc: Your one-stop-shop for all things cruise; bringing you the hottest destinations, ground-breaking ships and the latest deals to ensure your next cruise is your greatest one!

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Lost & Hound: The Schroeders rescue stranded dogs at sea. At the clinic vets treat a mule, cat and gecko and perform an emergency C-section. 7+ (S5, ep 2)

programme.title: Heartland Docs
programme.desc: Tongue Not in Cheek: Tensions rise at Cedar County Vets: a blocked cat, a St. Bernard with a painful tongue infection and a cow facing deadly bloat - every moment matters. (S5, ep 4)

programme.title: Super Squirrel
programme.desc: Documentary exploring the secret lives of squirrels. Having invaded the cities, these bushy-tailed critters now live side by side with us. But how much do we know about them? 7+

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Oh, Pol-Y Night: It's Christmas season in Michigan and Dr Pol and his team treat Tink and Lola, two dogs who are desperately in need of help. (S6, ep 10)

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Wizard of Paws: From limping labradors to damaged Danes, it's a dog's world as the team treat man's best friend. But after a busy day, an afterhours emergency arrives. (S6, ep 11)

programme.title: Hannah Fry in Vietnam
